tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Third Party Audit Agency for Managing the Transactions and Providing Web Based Application with End-To-End Online Process for KSRTC Health.
tenderSchedule.locationName: Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Conference Hall of KSRTC, Central Offices, K. H. Road, Shanthinagar, Bengaluru-560 027

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a.The Bidder should be a company incorporated in India under the Companies Act 1956/2013 and subsequent amendments there to-Bidder should submit Company Registered Certificate/s. b. The bidder should submit valid documentary proof of GST registration. c. The bidder should submit valid ISO 9001:2015 for quality process or higher. d. The bidder should have minimum Annual average turnover of Rs.1.00 Crores for preceding continuous three years as on date on publishing RFP notice. Bidder should submit Audited Statement of Accounts viz. Balance Sheet, Trading /Profit and Loss Accounts for preceding continuous three years. i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Certificate issued by the CA in respect of turn over for preceding continuous three years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. e. The firm should have positive net worth for preceding continuous three years as on date on publishing RFP notice. Firm should submit Certificate duly signed by statutory Auditor or certificate from Chartered Accountant of the bidder.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: f. The bidder should be registered company / organization / establishment in India minimum of 3 years experience in managing similar Health Care Scheme for state/Central Government Department/Organization OR Trusts being formed by the State/Central Governments in India. Proof of experience in managing similar Health care scheme for State/Central Governments in formed by the State/Central Governments in India for minimum 3 years. Copies of the work orders. Satisfactory completion certificate issued by the Client (Must tally with the work orders furnished). g. The bidder should have been operating for at least last three years in India as on the date of publishing of RFP notice (including name change/impact of mergers or acquisitions). Bidder should submit Certificate of incorporation which is issued by any State/Central Government department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: h. Covered an average of 24000 claims per year during preceding continuous three years.(Both the cases of Inpatient and Outpatient will be considered for experience). The bidder should submit satisfactory clients certificate as per the format Annexure D. i. The bidder should have a support office/Service Centers in Karnataka, preferably in Bangalore as on the date of tender submission. Bidder should submit valid establishment registration or GST registration Certificate of the Bidding entity shall be furnished. j. The bidder should deploy the Manpower/executives for managing the transactions of KRSTC Health Scheme as defined in scope of the work. Bidders entity shall furnish the details of CVs of Man power/Executives who will be deployed for managing transactions. k. The bidder should submit the following document along with Bid documents. Deliverables offered by the bidder in managing the KSRTC Health Scheme transactions as a nodal functionalities and performance characteristics of the Web based application being offered.The bidder to submit the Affidavit signed by Authorized Signatory on Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs.20/-or above. as per format. Annexure-E. l. The bidder should not be declared bankrupt or in the process of insolvency proceedings. Self-declaration by the bidder duly notarized and signed by Authorized Signatory on Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs.100. Annexure- F. m. The bidder should not be blacklisted or debarred as on the date of the bid submission by any Govt. Organization/ Agency in India (qualification for international firms) or operating under restricted orders of National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) for unsatisfactory performance, corrupt, fraudulent or any other unethical business practices by any Govt. Department/Agency in any State of India. Self-declaration by the bidder duly notarized and signed by Authorized Signatory on Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/-. Annexure-G.
